verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud's pricing page advertises Krisp-powered noise and background-voice elimination aimed at preventing false interruptions. That is a first-party audio-filtering capability tied to this story, but it is evidenced only by a single marketing line. missing for 10: documentation of how to enable or configure noise suppression in a pipeline, evidence of framework-level (self-hosted) audio filters, details on telephony/noisy-call behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls

citations.quote: Eliminates background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, powered by Krisp.
